epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 仰望北美洲的天際,體驗強大而絢麗的自然現象.見證北極熊在極光下尋找食物,追蹤極地渦旋的冰冷路徑,並跟隨草原犬鼠家族躲避猛烈的龍捲風.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience the powerful, colourful phenomena that swirl across the heavens in North America. Watch polar bears search for food under the aurora borealis, map the frigid path of a polar vortex, and elude violent tornadoes with a prairie dog family.

epg.programme_title_tc: 金伯利:澳洲的狂野西境 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沉浸在地球上最大,保存最完整的稀樹草原之中;在那裡,哺乳動物和昆蟲都能毫不費力地飛掠空中.了解傳統的野火管理方法,探索一處砂岩避難地,並看著一隻蜜袋鼯試著逃離火焰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bask in the largest intact savannah on the planet, where mammals and insects fly through the air with the greatest of ease. Study traditional wildfire-management methods, explore a sandstone refuge, and watch a sugar glider try to escape the flames.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 以澳洲最近發生災難性森林大火的後續,透過充滿希望,人為干預和復原力的故事,記錄野生動植物的長期恢復情況.本節目發放了一個十萬火急的訊息,不要太遲愛護大自然.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Examine fires pivotal role in shaping Australias natural world. Tour the devastation left by 2020s brutal bush-fire season, learn how climate change fuelled this watershed event, and chart the long-term recovery of the continents wildlife.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 美國地大物博充滿奇觀.大角羊在山頂躁動.棕熊在戰鬥,奮不顧身為冬天囤脂.尖尾松雞在舞池中搖擺尾羽.野生種馬優美地踏步.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The USA is big on flash and spectacle. Bighorn rams rattle the mountaintops. Brown bears battle, desperate to fatten up for winter. Sharp-tailed grouse shake their tail-feathers on the dance floor. Wild stallions rumble with beauty and grace.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在戈莫提河迎接春天的來臨,豹媽媽費芙和獅媽媽莎芭正在教導她們的幼寶寶如何在危機四伏的野外求存,並讓他們遠離成年雄性的威脅.看看獅王莫雷洛如何戰鬥,獵豹森娜蒂亞則試圖在戰場上證明自己的地位.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Welcome spring on the Gomoti River, where cheetah mum Phefo and lion mum Tshaba teach their cubs survival skills and keep them out of the jaws of the big male cats. See lion king Molelo go into battle while leopard Senatia tries to ensure his legacy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 緊貼莫雷洛獅群的行蹤;當冬季洪水到來時,他們因照顧幼獅而精疲力盡.見證獵豹幼寶寶如何作出艱難的決定,並目擊豹媽媽塞菲麗在經歷一場可怕的遭遇後,如何在自己家族與幼寶寶之間作出抉擇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Track Molelos pride, who are exhausted by cub care when the winter floods arrive. Check on the cheetah cubs, who make a difficult decision, and witness a scary encounter that makes leopard mum Sephiri choose between her old family and her new cubs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當家庭分崩離析,一隻幼獅必須活下來; 兩隻青少年豹崽在被遺棄後必須自生自滅,一隻年輕的成年黑羚必須冒上生命和肢體的危險,因牠試圖保證第一次交配.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young lion cub must survive as his family is torn apart; two adolescent leopard cubs must fend for themselves after they are abandoned, and a young adult blackbuck must risk life and limb as he tries to secure his first mating.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華贊是一頭強大的雄性領袖,坐擁一個異常龐大的部隊.他在維持這個大集團方面做得很好,但未來的路並不明朗.還有更多的同伴需要糊口,但牠的叢林正在萎縮.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rajan is the powerful alpha male who sits at the head of an unusually large troop. He has done well to sustain such a big group, but the future doesnt look so bright. There are more mouths to feed, and yet his jungle home is shrinking.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 豪華的廟宇花園坐落在古城焦特布爾的邊緣位置,是一大群長尾葉猴的家,牠們享受著寧靜的生活,卻有嚴格的等級制度.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Nestled on the edge of the ancient city of Jodhpur, the luxurious Temple Gardens are home to a huge troop of Hanuman Langurs, who enjoy a peaceful life of bounty. But the troop has a strict hierarchy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在印度南部炎熱又潮濕的熱帶森林中,一位雌性眼鏡王蛇正在執行任務:在季候風到來前,她需要找到伴侶,食物並順利下蛋.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the hot forest of Southern India, a female King Cobra is on a mission: to find a mate, find food, and lay eggs before the monsoon arrives.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在印度南部的森林中,夏季無情的酷熱給亞洲大象帶來了挑戰,他們每天都需要喝水.當水開始在周圍消失時,聰明的女族長安露娜決定帶領她的家人遷移到遙遠的水源.她能否成功為3個月大的孫子找到新水源?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In southern India, the summer is a challenge for Asian elephants who must drink every day. As things dry up, Anura, the matriarch, leads her herd to a distant watering hole. But will she succeed in getting her 3-month-old grandson there in time?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在鬣狗家族中有一個新面孔. 斑斑註定要成為位於尚比亞盧安瓜谷心臟地帶斑鬣狗族群的首領.她自出生起已有崇高身份,但她仍然需要證明自己.族群是一個危險的地方,她必須為自己打出一席位.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Spotty, a female hyena cub, is destined to be leader of the Chimbwe clan that lives in the heart of Zambias Luangwa Valley. But she has yet to prove herself. Witness her fight to find her place in this savagely competitive family.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們將帶領您環繞著赤道,深入探索居住在熱帶森林中的多樣物種,您將有機會遇見一隻獨自打造迷你森林的樹懶,與共享互助的狐猴,以及細心照料林地花園的象群,隨後,我們將一同揭開熱帶森林的神秘面紗.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Circle the equator for a look at the diverse species that dwell in tropical forests. Meet a lone sloth growing a mini-forest, lemurs that share and share alike, and elephants that tend to their woodland gardens. Then explore the regions dark side.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與我們一同欣賞四季更迭,並深入了解樹木和動物如何相互依賴共生.在夜幕低垂之際,欣賞在春天夜晚翩翩起舞的螢火蟲,探索協助樹木降溫的夏季菌菇,並在秋葉紛飛之際為秋季的來臨做好準備.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Watch the seasons wax and wane and learn how trees and animals help one another survive. Witness spring fireflies dancing after dark, discover summer fungi that cool off overheated trees, and prep for autumn migrations as the leaves begin to fall.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與我們一同踏入樹林與水源共同孕育新生命的溼地,再潛入保護年幼海狗的水下森林,拜訪一群藏身在紅樹林保護區的好奇水下古怪生物,同時你還有機會一窺真實存在的沼澤怪物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wade into wetlands, where trees and water meet to nurture new life. Dive into an underwater forest that protects young fur seals, visit a mangrove sanctuary where a curious band of aquatic misfits hides out, and meet some real-life swamp monsters.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索地球上的森林如何連結和滋養著無數物種的生命.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Climb into a realm of thin air and towering rock. Tag along as mythical monkeys battle for a winter food stash, sing along with lemurs in a fruit-filled tree canopy, and watch an aromatic tree bring together blossom and possum in a moonlit tryst.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​和獅子西爾加一起踏上狂野之旅,她的人類好友瓦爾自她還是失去父母的幼崽時就一直在她身邊.看烏鴉洛基逗樂他的摯友艾略特,與魟魚哈格爾依偎擁抱,並了解為什麼無尾熊崔許與蓋瑞就像一家人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Walk on the wild side with Sirga the lion, whose human pal, Val, has been by her side since she was an orphaned cub. See Loki the raven entertain his BFF Elliott, cuddle with Hugger the stingray, and see why Trish and Garri the koala are like family.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在由駱駝艾伯特與他的人類朋友亞歷克斯共同打理的牧場巡視,接著探訪小袋鼠賀比,他正被好友弗勒細心照顧.與袋鼬昆西一起製造一點混亂,並和衝浪山羊丘帕卡布拉一起掛在浪上.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Do rounds on the ranch that Albert the camel runs with his human friend Alex, then check in with Herbie the wallaby as he gets pampered by his pal Fleur. Cause a little chaos with Quincy the quoll and hang ten with Chupacabra the surfing goat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​跟隨夏內特,她每天照料岩跳企鵝哈羅德・卡斯塔德,並在巴里斯塔照顧她的好友辛蒂狒狒度過黃金歲月時,感受愛意.稍後,在羅科袋熊重返野外時,帶著情感道別.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow Shanet, who spends her days tending to the needs of Harold Custard the rockhopper penguin, and feel the love as Barista cares for Cindy the baboon in her golden years. Later, say an emotional goodbye as Rocco the wombat returns to the wild.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​為家養驢凱許的生日慶祝,接著與臭鼬米爾頓玩捉迷藏.認識海狸比約納,他有一份非常重要的工作,並與樹袋鼠班特利及他的人類媽媽一起探索擁抱與午睡的重要性.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Celebrate Cash the house donkeys birthday, then play hide-and-seek with Milton the skunk. Meet Bjornar the beaver, who has a very important job, and explore the importance of cuddles and naps with Bentley the tree kangaroo and his human mum.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在婆羅洲,明猩學園剛開始了一個全新學期.一起來見證新生布米努力集中注意力,害羞的倫巴邁出獨立的重要一步,並為明猩學生瓦倫蒂諾在大學的波折起步加油打氣.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Start a promising new term at the Orangutan Jungle School in Borneo. See newbie Bumi struggle to focus, track skittish Rumbas first timid steps toward independence, and cheer on star student Valentino as he experiences a bumpy start to college.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨剛畢業的貝尼,與同學蘇拉,梅里爾和威恩,一起展開明猩學園導賞團.拜訪剛報到的新生莫莉,並與納丁博士一起上課,看她如何為慢吞吞的布米和野孩子莫妮塔評分.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow new graduate Beni, who gets an exciting introduction to jungle college alongside former classmates Sura, Meryl, and Wine. Check on new arrival Molly and join Dr. Nadine as she grades slowpoke Bumi and wild child Monita on their latest lessons.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一起來看看貪吃鬼貝尼如何闖禍,並從當地的雄性領袖彼得魯克得到令其顫抖的教訓.見證曾經是非法寵物的富家孩子斯潘瑟,如何嘗試控制自己的甜食癮,再跟隨布米和格蕾塔進行一次瘋狂的冒險.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Shudder as food-obsessed Beni gets a dramatic, educational smackdown from the local dominant male, Petruk. See spoiled rich kid Spanser, a former illegal pet, try to tamp down his sweet tooth before roguish Bumi goes on a wild joyride with Greta.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​和獅子西爾加一起踏上狂野之旅,她的人類好友瓦爾自她還是失去父母的幼崽時就一直在她身邊.看烏鴉洛基逗樂他的摯友艾略特,與魟魚哈格爾依偎擁抱,並了解為什麼無尾熊崔許與蓋瑞就像一家人.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從高地到阿爾卑斯山,歐洲令人回味的景致成為了野生動物劇的史詩式背景.通常,堅忍的歐洲馬鹿在發情期會變得狂野,狼群發生領土衝突,狐狸踏著狐步- 這並非聽起來般美好.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From the Highlands to the Alps, Europes evocative landscapes are the backdrop for epic wildlife drama. Normally stoic red deer go wild during the rut. Wolf packs clash over territory, and foxes do the foxtrot - its not as nice as it sounds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 東部灰大袋鼠是最善於交際的袋鼠科動物之一,以稱之為暴徒的小社群聚居.暴徒就像袋鼠的社交網絡,由2至100隻袋鼠一起餵哺.成員可自出自入,視乎食物供應情況而定.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Eastern Grey kangaroo is a sociable species, clustering together in small groups known as mobs. A mob is a social network focused on feeding, where members will come and go as they please, depending on the availability of food.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 養育袋鼠寶寶充滿挑戰性:掠食者,極端天氣和非常活潑的小袋鼠意味著袋鼠媽媽每天都要努力讓下一代存活.本集跟隨兩位袋鼠媽媽 - 羅倫和蒂莉,且看她們如何努力養育孩子.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Eastern Grey kangaroos are prolific breeders, but bringing up baby is fraught with challenges. Predators, climate extremes, and lively joeys mean kangaroo mothers face a daily struggle to keep their young alive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 對於雄性袋鼠來說,努力繁衍代表著充滿風險和回報的生活.雖然女性生活在既定的家園內,並以和平的社群聚集,但男性的生活則十分危險.很多雄性袋鼠在鄉郊徘徊尋找伴侶.這讓他們接觸更多雌性,但一直移動代表他們面臨更多來自多變氣候,繁忙道路和可能遭農民射殺的危險.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow several different males as they roam the land, climb up the social ladder, and fight for their mating rights in Eastern Grey colony. For these bucks, the drive to perpetuate their species promises a life full of risk and reward.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 熱帶太平洋生活中的一天.在小島上,科莫多巨蜥爭奪食物殘渣,而招潮蟹則在海灘上決鬥.在海底,蝠鱝於深海滑翔,奇特的行走鯊魚在色彩斑斕的珊瑚礁中巡邏.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Live through a sunny tropical September day with creatures from Polynesia to the Indonesian archipelago. See how the sun affects the movement, feeding habits, and mating rituals of everything from tiny zooplankton to whale sharks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是澳洲春季的第一天,從風流的樹熊到拳擊袋鼠,再到選擇今天開餐令人驚訝地快速的眼斑巨蜥,獨特的動物們就開始春日狂熱.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Celebrate the first day of spring with Aussie creatures looking for either a dinner or a date. From the kangaroos in the grasslands to the koalas in the trees to the freshwater crocodiles, they hunt for food or fight for breeding rights.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬達加斯加展開雨季的一天.環尾狐猴和七彩的變色龍帶領一群獨特的動物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet the unique primates and reptiles searching for water and dodging predators, from ring-tailed lemurs in the east coast rainforests to tiny brown leaf chameleons, in this land of extreme climate variations and habitats.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 太陽在這個乾旱的半島上統管一切,尤其是在七月.但從單峰駱駝到如幻術師般的科威特蜥蜴,再到可愛的蹄兔,牠們都有特殊的適應能力來抵抗沙漠的高溫.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Visit one of the most arid and hottest parts of the world to discover how dhub lizards and dromedary camels adapted to withstand the intense conditions. Then move into the more moderate southern mountains, where rare hyrax and chameleons forage.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 脆弱又難以捉摸的豹貓在許多國家都屬於瀕危物種.但在世上最大的熱帶濕地之一的潘塔納爾濕地的南部邊界,這種驚豔的野貓似乎打算捲土重來.一群年輕的野生動物科學家正試圖瞭解原因.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join a group of wildlife scientists tracking the comeback of the ocelot in the Pantanal. Check in on their network of trail cameras, which capture the movements of this elusive spotted cat, and see the perils it faces, including giant anacondas.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在巴西亞馬遜熱帶雨林南部邊界的一片受保護森林中,居住著新世界最聰明和最敏捷的猴子之一 - 亞馬遜蛛猴.長尾巴就如牠們的第五個肢體,牠們很少離開森林的樹梢而走到地面.牠們是森林的「大使」.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get an inside look at the Pantanals most extraordinary primate families. Check out the ear-splitting cries of howler monkeys, the fearless leaps of curious saki monkeys, and the agile tails of highly intelligent white-whiskered spider monkeys.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在潘塔納爾濕地的北部邊緣,地球上最大的熱帶濕地之一,有一個小池塘,是一個罕有的囓齒類動物的家園.牠們不是典型的老鼠或松鼠 - 這些巨鼠的大小與綿羊相若!在乾燥季節的中期,這個群體有數十個嬰兒需要養育並接受保護.挑戰就如牠們的身型一樣大,這些溫和的巨人在許多捕食者的菜單上.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: At the northern edge of the Pantanal, in one of the largest tropical wetlands on Earth, is a small pond that is home to an unusual family of rodents. They are not your typical rats or squirrels - these giants are the size of sheep!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每年旱季,隨著洪水消失,潘塔納爾濕地的草原就成為許多物種的家:巨型食蟻獸,鬃狼和更大的品種 - 南美洲最大的鳥類.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Every year in the dry season, as the floodwaters disappear, the grasslands of the Pantanal are home to many species: giant anteaters, maned wolves and the greater rheas- the largest bird in South America.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在潘塔納爾濕地的南部邊緣,地球上最大的熱帶濕地之一,生物學家卡露蓮娜莉巴絲和她的當地導遊,亞莉莉泰蓮娜尋找一個巨大的水獺巢穴.儘管體型龐大,嘈雜且具有群居性質,這班瀕臨絕種的巨型水獺卻是出了名的害羞而且難以被找到.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join biologists on a hike through a giant otter refuge in the southern Pantanal. Will they find these shy, elusive animals or just the evidence of their day-to-day lives? On the trail, check in on amorous tapirs and water-loving Muscovy ducks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 窺探全球昆蟲數量銳減對地球可能造成的衝擊,揭露我們千百年來對這些微小伙伴的依賴,以及牠們在生態系統中所扮演的關鍵角色.了解人類與昆蟲之間的微妙關係如何面臨危機.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Look at what a global insect decline could do to our planet. Uncover our historical dependence on these tiny animals, the vital roles they play in our ecosystems, and the reasons why our fragile relationship to them is in danger worldwide.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 了解蜜蜂,蝴蝶與飛蛾如何讓田野和樹林充滿生機.想像如果這些勤勞的蟲蟲消失,世界會如何變樣.見證神祕的蝴蝶遷徙之旅,以及飛蛾如何巧妙地躲避飢餓的蝙蝠.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Learn how bees, butterflies, moths, and other pollinators keep our fields and forests fruitful, and weigh what life would be like if these busy bugs vanished. Witness a mysterious butterfly pilgrimage and a moths clever way of escaping hungry bats.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 迎戰專為殺戮而生的掠食性昆蟲,了解具有武術家身手的螳螂如何令人畏懼,然後跟隨大開殺戒的蜻蜓在半空中狩獵.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Go up against predatory insects that are tailor-made for killing. See why the terrifying praying mantis has the agility of a martial artist and an appetite for everything from flies to hummingbirds, then go hunting in mid-air with deadly dragonflies.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 向大自然的清潔專家學習環境衛生課.了解甲蟲如何利用尖牙與毒液等生物武器,巧妙維持生態平衡,並認識超過六千種的糞金龜──這些無名英雄才是維護地球健康的關鍵.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get a sanitation lesson from natures original cleanup crew. Learn how beetles keep ecosystems in balance with clever biological weapons like tusks and toxic sprays, then see why the 6,000-plus species of dung beetles are the worlds unsung heroes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 伴隨著一個獨特的鳥類家族的穩定鼓點行進.了解為何世界上從大到小的239種啄木鳥都是自然界最好的伐木工;探索牠們的飛行,攀爬和呼叫技能;進入牠們的秘密巢穴一探究竟.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: March to the steady drumbeat of a unique avian family. Learn why the worlds 239 woodpecker species, from massive to minute, are natures best lumberjacks; explore their flying, climbing, and calling skills; and get a look inside their secret nests.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 到非洲窺探野生動物終生不懈的尋找水源之旅.見證地球上最壯觀的海洋覓食狂潮,了解眼鏡蛇的太陽能儲備,並跟隨牛羚與大象家族踏上壯闊的遷徙之旅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Observe the eternal search for water that defines the lives of Africas wild animals. Witness the biggest marine feeding frenzy on Earth, see how cobras stock up on solar power, and join wildebeest herds and elephant clans on their epic migrations.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 了解南美洲多變的氣候如何孕育更豐富多樣的生命.尋找亞馬遜雨林中能夠「呼吸」氧氣的樹木,追隨廣闊的雲河軌跡,並拜會能在猛烈紫外線下茁壯成長的紅鶴.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Learn how South Americas rich diversity of weather fuels an even richer diversity of life. Examine the Amazon rainforests oxygen-breathing trees, follow the arc of a vast cloud river, and meet flamingos that thrive in the suns scorching UV rays.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 窺探全球昆蟲數量銳減對地球可能造成的衝擊,揭露我們千百年來對這些微小伙伴的依賴,以及牠們在生態系統中所扮演的關鍵角色.了解人類與昆蟲之間的微妙關係如何面臨危機.

epg.programme_title_en: Loch Lomond: A Year In The Wild #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 春天來了,遷徙的魚鷹重返公園.懷孕的歐洲馬鹿下山到低地產子.兩隻大公雞在山腰為了爭奪交配權,而展開一場名為力的奇觀.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It is spring, and migrating ospreys return to the park. Pregnant red deer come down from the mountain tops to the lowlands to calve. On a mountainside, two big cocks fight for the right to mate in a spectacle called a lek.

epg.programme_title_en: Loch Lomond: A Year In The Wild #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 現在是六月,公園沐浴在17個小時的日光之中.溫暖的氣溫帶來了豐收,但對新生兒來說,夏季很重要,因牠們要學習戰鬥,覓食和躲避掠食者.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It is now June, and the park is bathed in 17 hours of daylight. With the warm temperatures come rich pickings, but for the newborn the summer months are crucial as they learn to fight, find food and avoid predators.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 重新檢視新春攻勢:兩個月的戰役殺死了超過15,000名美國和盟軍士兵,並引發了美國各地的反戰示威.探索報告,圖像和戰鬥片段,當中大部分自1968年以後就再沒出現過.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rediscover the Tet Offensive: two months of battles that killed more than 15,000 American and Allied troops, and triggered anti-war protests across the U.S. Explore reports, images, and combat footage, much of which hasn’t been seen since 1968.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 按時序再體驗太陽神13號險些釀成的災難,這是美國太空總署同時最具破壞性和最美好的時刻之一.通過新聞片段,任務控制的音頻和美國太空總署的存檔見證1970年4月的事件.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience a chronological recounting of the Apollo 13 near-disaster, one of NASA’s most devastating-and finest-moments. Witness the events of April 1970 as they unfolded through news footage, mission control audio, and NASA archives.

epg.programme_title_en: How Did They Fix That? S2 #6
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米克大衛臣加入世上最極端,最容易發生雪崩的滑雪山之一- 雪鳥的團隊.他們使用鏟子,壓雪車,甚至二戰的榴彈砲,奮力保衛陡峭斜坡的安全.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mike Davidson embeds with the team of one of the most extreme, avalanche-prone mountain ski mountains in the world - Snowbird. They battle to keep the steep and deep slopes safe with shovels, snowcats and even a WWII Howitzer cannon.

epg.programme_title_en: How Did They Fix That? S2 #7
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米克大衛臣前往世上最大的自動化包裹分類設施 - 位於肯塔基州路易維爾的聯合包裹服務公司世界港.每天有200萬個包裹途經這裡,全靠幕後一班戴著安全帽的英雄實現這一切.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mike Davidson goes to the biggest automated package sorting facility in the world - UPS Worldport in Louisville, Kentucky. Two million packages go through here every day, and its up to the hardhat heroes behind the scenes to make it all happen.

epg.programme_title_en: How Did They Fix That? S2 #8
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米克大衛臣在費城的街道,隧道,軌道和電車修車庫中與團隊並肩合作,使美國最大,最古老的大眾交通系統之一暢順並準時運作.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Philadelphia, Mike Davidson is on streets, in tunnels, on tracks and in trolley restoration garages - working shoulder-to-shoulder with the team that keeps one of Americas largest and oldest mass transit systems running smoothly and on time.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沖繩是20世紀最後一場大戰中最後一仗的地點,傷亡數以萬計.軍事攝影師排除萬難冒著生命危險記錄這場衝突,從殘暴的陸戰到神風敢死隊激烈的海襲.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Okinawa was the site of the last battle of the last great war of the 20th century, with a casualty rate in the tens of thousands. Through it all, military cameramen risked their lives to film the conflict, from brutal land combat to fierce kamikaze a

epg.programme_title_en: Battle Of Midway: The True Story
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 深入瞭解中途島海戰,大戰時雙方使用的飛機,以及一位戰鬥機機師的戲劇性故事,還有他在美國第一次太平洋戰爭獲得真正勝利中的關鍵作用.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: An inside look at the Battle of Midway, the aircraft used on both sides of the fight, and the dramatic story of one fighter pilot and his pivotal role in America’s first true victory of the Pacific War.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沿著非洲南部海岸觀賞古老的海蝕洞,現代的高爾夫球場,神秘的地質構造和危險的掠食者.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: See ancient sea caves, modern golf courses, mysterious formations, and treacherous predators along Africas South Coast.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從空中俯瞰南非的山脈,繁囂的都市和野性難馴的動物.這是南非從史前骨頭到現代摩天大廈的旅程.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: View South Africas mountain ranges, bustling cities and untamed wildlife from the air. This is South Africas journey from pre-human skeletons to modern Skyscrapers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 翱翔於廣闊的沙漠,巨大的鑽石和 世上最大的內陸綠洲之上.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Soar over vast deserts, enormous diamonds, and the worlds largest inland oasis.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從數千英尺高空探索西開普省迷人的海岸線,注目的山脈和多樣性的大都會.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore the Western Capes stunning shorelines, dramatic mountains, and richly-diverse metropolis, from thousands of feet in the air.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 要觀察這片充滿地質現象的土地,只能從高空欣賞其雄偉的真面貌.從散佈在海岸線上被遺忘的沉船到卡奧科蘭無解的仙女圈,納米比亞的秘密將被揭開.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Observe a land filled with geological phenomena whose majesty can only truly be appreciated from the sky. From forgotten shipwrecks strewn along the coastline to the unexplained fairy circles in Koakoveld, Namibias secrets will be revealed.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在豐富多彩的非洲國家-尚比亞上空翱翔.包括世上最富有的人所打造的城市和擠滿世上最貧窮的人的市場.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Soar over the richly diverse, African nation of Zambia. Including cities crafted by the worlds richest men and markets teeming with some of the worlds poorest people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 重新檢視新春攻勢:兩個月的戰役殺死了超過15,000名美國和盟軍士兵,並引發了美國各地的反戰示威.探索報告,圖像和戰鬥片段,當中大部分自1968年以後就再沒出現過.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rediscover the Tet Offensive: two months of battles that killed more than 15,000 American and Allied troops, and triggered anti-war protests across the U.S. Explore reports, images, and combat footage, much of which hasn’t been seen since 1968.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米克大衛臣加入世上最極端,最容易發生雪崩的滑雪山之一- 雪鳥的團隊.他們使用鏟子,壓雪車,甚至二戰的榴彈砲,奮力保衛陡峭斜坡的安全.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mike Davidson embeds with the team of one of the most extreme, avalanche-prone mountain ski mountains in the world - Snowbird. They battle to keep the steep and deep slopes safe with shovels, snowcats and even a WWII Howitzer cannon.

epg.programme_title_en: Canada: A Year In The Wild #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 今年有一個遲來的春天,但當它終於來到,尋覓配偶和組織家庭的競賽就正式開展;西部的黑熊和海狸,南部的樹蛙,東部的兩萬隻塘鵝,不分地域都想著同一件事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Spring is late this year, and when it finally arrives, the race is on to find a mate and start a family; black bears and beavers in the west, wood frogs in the south and 20,000 gannets in the east all have one thing on their minds.

epg.programme_title_en: Canada: A Year In The Wild #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 夏季對大部分動物來說都是豐收的季節,但對北極熊卻相反.在海洋再度結冰前,牠們無法捕獵海豹,導致日益飢餓.對其他動物來說,夏天是幼崽們必須學習如何生存的時機.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Summer is the season of plenty for most animals, but not polar bears; unable to hunt seals until the sea freezes over again, they grow hungrier by the day; for other animals summer is when youngsters must learn how to survive.

epg.programme_title_en: Alaska: A Year In The Wild #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 冬季的結束預示世上最大型又瘋狂的覓食潮來臨,大型海洋獵食者瞄準在阿拉斯加灣尋求庇護的數百萬條魚.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The end of winter heralds one of the worlds greatest feeding frenzies as large ocean predators target the millions of fish who have found refuge in the Gulf of Alaska.

epg.programme_title_en: Growing Up Grizzly: A Tale Of Two Orphans
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 凱西安達臣撫養一隻名叫砵突士的熊孤兒18年後,將盡一切努力確保沒有熊生活在人造庇護所中.有一年,當他得知有兩隻灰熊幼崽成為孤兒後,他的決心受到考驗.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After 18 years of raising an orphaned bear named Brutus, Casey Anderson will do anything to ensure no bears have to live in a man made sanctuary. His resolve is put to the test one year when he is notified of 2 recently orphaned grizzly cubs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集講述了這些雄偉的座頭鯨的旅程,從覓食地到繁殖地,母鯨與幼鯨之間的溫柔時光,以及幼鯨在最初幾個月面臨的危險,包括與食肉鯨的驚人互動.座頭鯨還面臨著一個充滿人類威脅的世界,從大型貨櫃船到尋找石油和天然氣時地震測試的影響,現在這些威脅再次威脅到它們的生存.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode follows the journeys of these magnificent humpbacks, from their feeding grounds to their breeding grounds, the tender moments between mother and calf, and see the dangers their calves face in their first few months, including incredible

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 腔棘魚通常被稱為恐龍魚,在化石記錄中佔有獨特的地位,近一個世紀前重新發現它時震驚了科學界.我們跟隨它的旅程直到今天,陪同 WildOceans 的科學家進行探險,以揭開它們更多的秘密和行為.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Often referred to as the dinosaur fish, the coelacanth occupies a unique place in the fossil record, and when it was rediscovered almost a century ago it shook the scientific community. We follow its journey to the present day, accompanying WildOcean

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在《兩條鯊魚的故事》中,我們將看看南非海岸發現的各種各樣的鯊魚,重點關注瀕臨滅絕的路氏雙髻鯊和標誌性的大白鯊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In A Tale Of Two Sharks we take a look at the incredible array of sharks found off the South African coast, focusing on the endangered Scalloped Hammerhead and the iconic Great White.

epg.programme_title_en: Loch Lomond: A Year In The Wild #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 春天來了,遷徙的魚鷹重返公園.懷孕的歐洲馬鹿下山到低地產子.兩隻大公雞在山腰為了爭奪交配權,而展開一場名為力的奇觀.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It is spring, and migrating ospreys return to the park. Pregnant red deer come down from the mountain tops to the lowlands to calve. On a mountainside, two big cocks fight for the right to mate in a spectacle called a lek.

epg.programme_title_en: Loch Lomond: A Year In The Wild #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 現在是六月,公園沐浴在17個小時的日光之中.溫暖的氣溫帶來了豐收,但對新生兒來說,夏季很重要,因牠們要學習戰鬥,覓食和躲避掠食者.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It is now June, and the park is bathed in 17 hours of daylight. With the warm temperatures come rich pickings, but for the newborn the summer months are crucial as they learn to fight, find food and avoid predators.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這塊巨大的磁石將徹底改變世界和產能的未來.法國南部正建造目前世上最大的核融合反應堆.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This giant magnet will revolutionize the world and energy production in the future. The worlds largest nuclear fusion reactor is currently under construction in southern France.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 重新檢視新春攻勢:兩個月的戰役殺死了超過15,000名美國和盟軍士兵,並引發了美國各地的反戰示威.探索報告,圖像和戰鬥片段,當中大部分自1968年以後就再沒出現過.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rediscover the Tet Offensive: two months of battles that killed more than 15,000 American and Allied troops, and triggered anti-war protests across the U.S. Explore reports, images, and combat footage, much of which hasn’t been seen since 1968.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 按時序再體驗太陽神13號險些釀成的災難,這是美國太空總署同時最具破壞性和最美好的時刻之一.通過新聞片段,任務控制的音頻和美國太空總署的存檔見證1970年4月的事件.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience a chronological recounting of the Apollo 13 near-disaster, one of NASA’s most devastating-and finest-moments. Witness the events of April 1970 as they unfolded through news footage, mission control audio, and NASA archives.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這塊巨大的磁石將徹底改變世界和產能的未來.法國南部正建造目前世上最大的核融合反應堆.

epg.programme_title_en: Loch Lomond: A Year In The Wild #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 秋季是雄鹿爭相繁殖,魚鷹雛鳥開展3000英裡西非遷徙,三文魚返回牠們出生的河流,極北蝰產子的季節.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Autumn is when stags compete to breed, osprey chicks begin a 3000-mile migration to West Africa, salmon return to the rivers where they were born and adders give birth to live young.

epg.programme_title_en: Loch Lomond: A Year In The Wild #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 冬天溫和潮濕,對不同動物來說,是好消息,也可以是壞消息.歐洲馬鹿被逼移到更高的地方,三文魚已經半年沒有食物,山兔變成了顯眼的白色,松鼠將自己的幼崽趕出巢穴.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The winter is mild and wet, which is good news for some but bad news for others. Red deer are forced to higher ground, salmon have gone six months without food, mountain hares turn a conspicuous white, and squirrels kick their own young out of the ne

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利前往義大利西西里島的巴勒摩,並用上即捕的吞拿魚在海灘上準備海鮮麵食.他又品嚐了包括炸魷魚,釀沙甸魚和島上獨特香蒜醬的地道美食.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ainsley travels to Palermo on the Italian island of Sicily and prepares seafood pasta on the beach, using freshly caught tuna; Ainsley samples local delicacies including fried calamari, stuffed sardines and the islands unique recipe for pesto.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利前往臺灣,發現它是世上最偉大的美食聖地之一.他發現香燉魚和辣炒豬肉,並用大蒜和辣椒煮臺灣大蝦.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ainsley travels to Taiwan and discovers it is one of the greatest food destinations in the world. He finds fragrant braised fish and chilli pork stir-fry, and cooks Taiwan prawns with garlic and chilli.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利發現馬德裡是個充滿秘密的城市.首先這個沉迷美食的城市禁止街頭美食.那麼當地人如何繞過這道禁令呢?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ainsley discovers that Madrid is a city of secrets. The first one comes as a bit of a shock: street food is banned in this food-obsessed city. So how do the locals get round this?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集探索年輕的諾瑪珍.在展現才華和膽色的同時,她拋開艱辛的童年,以瑪麗蓮夢露的身份進入好萊塢.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode explores the young Norma Jeane. While showing talent and audacity, she turned her back on her difficult childhood and put herself on the radar in Hollywood as 『Marilyn Monroe』.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集探討瑪麗蓮如何反對裸體,以及她怎樣一躍成星.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode explores Marilyn’s defiance about posing nude and how it catapults her to stardom.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集探索瑪麗蓮決心成為認真的演員,以及她離開二十世紀霍士創辦自己的製作公司.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode explores Marilyn’s determination to become a serious actress and her departure from Twentieth Century Fox to start her own production company.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 生命自會找到出路!隨風漂流而來的物種,讓加勒比海成為全球生物多樣性熱點.深入探索這些迷人而脆弱的翡翠生態系,感受海島生機.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Life finds a way! Blown by winds and washed ashore, the Caribbean is now a mesmerizing hotspot of global biodiversity. Explore these fragile, emerald ecosystems and their incredible island resilience.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 穿越時空!探索昆士蘭古老的濕地與原生雨林.這裡棲息著史前時代的倖存者,帶您踏上一場通往熱帶澳洲起源的生命活力之旅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Step back in time! Explore Queensland’s ancient wetlands and primary rainforests. Home to survivors of prehistoric eras, it’s a vibrant journey to the very origins of tropical Australia.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 國土雖小,震撼巨大!哥斯大黎加擁有全球 5% 的物種.從山巔到海岸,親身體會守護這座豐富生命聖殿對地球是多麼至關重要.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Small country, massive impact! Costa Rica hosts 5% of all Earths species. Trek from peaks to shores to see why protecting this rich, living sanctuary is an absolute necessity for our planet.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 由牠們的齒與爪,到令人難以置信的隱身和狡猾,大自然最致命的掠食者進化出一系列令人震驚的狩獵技術.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From their teeth, and claws, to incredible stealth and cunning, nature’s most lethal predators have evolved a staggering array of hunting techniques.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集見證大自然最非凡的動物遷徙,並發現牠們為了生存而必須出走多遠.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode we witness nature’s most extraordinary animal migrations, and discover the lengths they must go to, in order to survive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 動物嬰兒:為了嬰兒免受極端情況,飢餓掠食者和飢餓威脅,所有動物都必須為其物種的未來而戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Baby Animals: Protecting babies against extreme conditions, hungry predators, and the threat of starvation, all animals must fight for the future of their species.

epg.programme_title_en: Battle Of Midway: The True Story
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 深入瞭解中途島海戰,大戰時雙方使用的飛機,以及一位戰鬥機機師的戲劇性故事,還有他在美國第一次太平洋戰爭獲得真正勝利中的關鍵作用.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: An inside look at the Battle of Midway, the aircraft used on both sides of the fight, and the dramatic story of one fighter pilot and his pivotal role in America’s first true victory of the Pacific War.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從巨型媒體帝國的女繼承人到被通緝的重犯,見證1974年的派蒂赫茲綁架奇案.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From heiress of a giant media empire to wanted felon, witness the strange saga of the Patty Hearst kidnapping of 1974.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 以當時報導山姆之子的方式呈現事件,讓你沉浸在這謀殺案的戲劇中.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Immerse yourself in the drama of the Son of Sam murders, presented the way the events were covered at the time.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在豐富多彩的非洲國家-尚比亞上空翱翔.包括世上最富有的人所打造的城市和擠滿世上最貧窮的人的市場.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Soar over the richly diverse, African nation of Zambia. Including cities crafted by the worlds richest men and markets teeming with some of the worlds poorest people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沿著非洲南部海岸觀賞古老的海蝕洞,現代的高爾夫球場,神秘的地質構造和危險的掠食者.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: See ancient sea caves, modern golf courses, mysterious formations, and treacherous predators along Africas South Coast.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奧克蘭動物園的獸醫團隊開始進行加護治療來拯救一隻被魚線纏住的瀕危海龜的生命.在動物園欠缺老虎三年後,團隊準備好迎接一隻新的大貓.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Auckland Zoo’s vet team commences critical care to save the life of an endangered sea turtle snared on a fishing line, and after 3 years without tigers at the Zoo, the team stand by to welcome a new big cat.

epg.programme_title_en: Loch Lomond: A Year In The Wild #4

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這具百萬年歷史的巨大杜爾福長毛象骨骸,急需進行世界首創的緊急修復.我們跟隨這個艱鉅的拆卸和重組脆弱化石的過程.透過電腦成像技術(CGI)和博物館知識,這部影片讓這個引人入勝卻鮮為人知的巨型生物重獲生命.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The million-year-old, giant Durfort mammoth skeleton required urgent, world-first restoration. We follow the tricky process of disassembling and reassembling the fragile fossil. Through CGI and museum knowledge, the film brings this fascinating, litt

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 討人喜歡,被視為滑稽的海鸚是冰島的國家象徵,但牠的命運令人擔憂.長達十年,海鸚伴侶停止繁殖.少數當地熱心人士現已動員起來,力挽狂瀾,拯救這種備受喜愛的海鳥.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The endearing, comical puffin is Icelands national emblem, but its fate is concerning. For a decade, couples have stopped breeding. A handful of local enthusiasts are now mobilized to save this beloved seabird.

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S4 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Ben 來到黑斯廷斯,發現當地以整合式的全方位方法生產草飼安格斯牛肉.他造訪在地農夫市集,認識了許多優秀的本地食品生產者,展現出這個地區豐饒的農產品.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ben’s travels to Hastings and discovers a holistic fully vertically integrated approach to creating grass fed Angus beef. He ventures to the local farmers market and meets amazing local food producers, reinforcing the abundance of produce grown in th

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S4 #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Ben 拜訪了一位果園經營者與食品創新專家.他們共同的願景是製作天然,以品種為主導的蘋果汁,並採用世界最先進的技術.他也參觀了位於霍克斯灣地中海型氣候下所培育的超過三十種無花果.

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S4 #5

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S4 #7
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Ben 體驗魯阿佩胡地區正崛起的飲食文化,以及悠久的市集園藝歷史.他拜訪了一位第六代農夫,該農夫將一片偏遠荒野打造成繁榮的生態旅遊與高級餐飲目的地,並與一位屢獲殊榮的主廚合作.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集探索瑪麗蓮決心成為認真的演員,以及她離開二十世紀霍士創辦自己的製作公司.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode explores Marilyn’s determination to become a serious actress and her departure from Twentieth Century Fox to start her own production company.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集探索瑪麗蓮如何展現她成熟的演員天賦,還有紅顏薄命的她剛戰勝二十世紀霍士就香消玉殞.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode explores how Marilyn shows her mature talent as an actress and wins a triumphant victory over Twentieth Century Fox shortly before her untimely death.

epg.programme_title_tc: 揭秘芭比:分裂的夢幻屋
epg.programme_title_en: Barbie Uncovered: A Dream House Divided
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《揭秘芭比:分裂的夢幻屋》揭示創作芭比娃娃背後的戲劇性真實故事,重點講述聯合創作者羅絲韓德勒和傑克瑞恩的高山與低谷,以及他們標誌性又備受爭議發明的持久影響.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Barbie Uncovered reveals the dramatic true story behind Barbie’s creation, spotlighting the rise and fallout of co-creators Ruth Handler and Jack Ryan, and the lasting impact of their iconic, controversial invention.

epg.programme_title_en: Canada: A Year In The Wild #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 今年有一個遲來的春天,但當它終於來到,尋覓配偶和組織家庭的競賽就正式開展;西部的黑熊和海狸,南部的樹蛙,東部的兩萬隻塘鵝,不分地域都想著同一件事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Spring is late this year, and when it finally arrives, the race is on to find a mate and start a family; black bears and beavers in the west, wood frogs in the south and 20,000 gannets in the east all have one thing on their minds.

epg.programme_title_en: Canada: A Year In The Wild #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 夏季對大部分動物來說都是豐收的季節,但對北極熊卻相反.在海洋再度結冰前,牠們無法捕獵海豹,導致日益飢餓.對其他動物來說,夏天是幼崽們必須學習如何生存的時機.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Summer is the season of plenty for most animals, but not polar bears; unable to hunt seals until the sea freezes over again, they grow hungrier by the day; for other animals summer is when youngsters must learn how to survive.

epg.programme_title_en: Alaska: A Year In The Wild #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 冬季的結束預示世上最大型又瘋狂的覓食潮來臨,大型海洋獵食者瞄準在阿拉斯加灣尋求庇護的數百萬條魚.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The end of winter heralds one of the worlds greatest feeding frenzies as large ocean predators target the millions of fish who have found refuge in the Gulf of Alaska.

epg.programme_title_en: Alaska: A Year In The Wild #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著春季來臨,日照變長,氣溫上升.不過,阿拉斯加只有短暫的春季.動物只有兩個月時間來覓食和組織家庭,還要避開獵食者.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With the arrival of spring, days grow longer and temperatures rise. However, spring in Alaska is short. Animals have just two months to find food and start a family, while avoiding predators.

epg.programme_title_en: Alaska: A Year In The Wild #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿拉斯加已進入夏季.這為世上最大規模之一的阿拉斯加三文魚遷徙準備了舞臺.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Summer has arrived in Alaska.This sets the scene for one of the worlds greatest migrations of the Alaskan salmon run.

epg.programme_title_en: Alaska: A Year In The Wild #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 座頭鯨回歸阿拉斯加豐饒的食堂,三文魚則回到河流產卵.不過,牠們必須跟飢餓的棕熊討一條生路.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Humpback whales return to Alaskas rich feeding grounds and salmon return to spawn in the rivers. The returning salmon however have to negotiate a path past hungry brown bears.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 以當時報導山姆之子的方式呈現事件,讓你沉浸在這謀殺案的戲劇中.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Immerse yourself in the drama of the Son of Sam murders, presented the way the events were covered at the time.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《生存邊緣》檢視全球生物圈所面臨的存亡威脅,以及對地球和奧特亞羅瓦(紐西蘭)的未來代表著甚麼.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Edge of Existence examines existential threats to the worlds biosphere and what it means for the future of the planet, and Aotearoa.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《生存邊緣》探索人類有史以來面臨的最大存亡風險之一的未來- 一個生化威脅.從病毒到人造流行病和合成生化武器,科技正加速人造威脅的風險.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Edge of Existence explores a future where bio-threats present one of the greatest existential risks that humanity has ever faced. From viruses to man-made pandemics and synthetic bio-weapons, technology is accelerating the risks of man-made threats.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沿著非洲南部海岸觀賞古老的海蝕洞,現代的高爾夫球場,神秘的地質構造和危險的掠食者.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: See ancient sea caves, modern golf courses, mysterious formations, and treacherous predators along Africas South Coast.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從空中俯瞰南非的山脈,繁囂的都市和野性難馴的動物.這是南非從史前骨頭到現代摩天大廈的旅程.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: View South Africas mountain ranges, bustling cities and untamed wildlife from the air. This is South Africas journey from pre-human skeletons to modern Skyscrapers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奧克蘭動物園的獸醫團隊開始進行加護治療來拯救一隻被魚線纏住的瀕危海龜的生命.在動物園欠缺老虎三年後,團隊準備好迎接一隻新的大貓.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Auckland Zoo’s vet team commences critical care to save the life of an endangered sea turtle snared on a fishing line, and after 3 years without tigers at the Zoo, the team stand by to welcome a new big cat.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Joe Biden became the 46th US President on Jan 20, 2021, promising unity and calm after a divided era, aiming to restore the soul of America.

epg.programme_title_en: Cristiano Ronaldo: The One And Only
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從年輕的葡萄牙神童開始見證有史以來最偉大的球員之一的旅程.這是絕無僅有的...基斯坦勞朗拿度.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness the journey from the young Portuguese prodigy to one of the greatest players of all time. This is the one and only...Cristiano Ronaldo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 講述唱片銷量超過1億哥倫比亞出生的超級巨星莎琦拉的故事;還有她堅定不移的倡議和慈善努力,使她成為有類似志向的藝人和粉絲的榜樣.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Following the story of Shakira, the Columbian born superstar who has sold over 100 million records; covering her unwavering advocacy and philanthropic efforts that make her a role model for aspiring artists and fans alike.

epg.programme_title_en: Bruce Lee: The Way Of The Warrior
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 李小龍,好萊塢電影的標誌性人物,武術先驅,但最重要的是,他是一位朋友.《武者之路》全面審視,由最親近的人講述李小龍的傳奇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bruce Lee, an iconic figure in Hollywood cinema, a pioneer of martial arts but most importantly, a friend. 『The Way of the Warrior』 takes a comprehensive look at the legend that is Bruce Lee, told by the people closest to him.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從山度士街頭到成為巴西隊頭號射手,內馬爾20年的歷程值得載入史冊.內馬爾幾乎在每個大洲都踢過足球,他將永遠成為球壇的傳說.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From the streets of Santos to becoming Brazils number one goal scorer, the 20-year journey of Neymar is one for the history books. Having played football on nearly every continent, Neymar will go down as a legend of the game, forever.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 傑拉德在長達20多年的輝煌職業生涯中體驗並成功晉身球壇巔峰,作為球員和教練捧起過獎盃,又代表過國家隊.但有高山就會伴隨低谷.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In an illustrious professional career that spans over 20 years, Gerrard has experienced and succeeded at the pinnacle of the sport, lifting trophies as a player and manager, and representing his country. But with the highs, came the lows.

epg.programme_title_en: Cristiano Ronaldo: The One And Only
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從年輕的葡萄牙神童開始見證有史以來最偉大的球員之一的旅程.這是絕無僅有的...基斯坦勞朗拿度.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness the journey from the young Portuguese prodigy to one of the greatest players of all time. This is the one and only...Cristiano Ronaldo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 祖拜登於2021年1月20日就任美國第46任總統,承諾在分裂的時代後團結和鎮靜,目標是恢復美國魂.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Joe Biden became the 46th US President on Jan 20, 2021, promising unity and calm after a divided era, aiming to restore the soul of America.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當川普的總統任期(2017-2021)在一片爭議和社會變革中過渡,對國家和世界產生了良久影響.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Donald Trumps presidency (2017-2021) was marked by controversy and societal shifts, leaving a lasting impact on the nation and world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 巴拉克歐巴馬是首位非裔美國總統,體現了希望,正義,寬容和平等,以他的信息和傳承啟發數百萬人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Barack Obama, the 1st African-American US President, embodied hope, justice, tolerance, and equality, inspiring millions with his message and legacy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 翱翔於廣闊的沙漠,巨大的鑽石和 世上最大的內陸綠洲之上.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Soar over vast deserts, enormous diamonds, and the worlds largest inland oasis.

epg.programme_title_en: Cristiano Ronaldo: The One And Only
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從年輕的葡萄牙神童開始見證有史以來最偉大的球員之一的旅程.這是絕無僅有的...基斯坦勞朗拿度.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness the journey from the young Portuguese prodigy to one of the greatest players of all time. This is the one and only...Cristiano Ronaldo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 講述唱片銷量超過1億哥倫比亞出生的超級巨星莎琦拉的故事;還有她堅定不移的倡議和慈善努力,使她成為有類似志向的藝人和粉絲的榜樣.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Following the story of Shakira, the Columbian born superstar who has sold over 100 million records; covering her unwavering advocacy and philanthropic efforts that make her a role model for aspiring artists and fans alike.

epg.programme_title_en: Bruce Lee: The Way Of The Warrior
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 李小龍,好萊塢電影的標誌性人物,武術先驅,但最重要的是,他是一位朋友.《武者之路》全面審視,由最親近的人講述李小龍的傳奇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bruce Lee, an iconic figure in Hollywood cinema, a pioneer of martial arts but most importantly, a friend. 『The Way of the Warrior』 takes a comprehensive look at the legend that is Bruce Lee, told by the people closest to him.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從山度士街頭到成為巴西隊頭號射手,內馬爾20年的歷程值得載入史冊.內馬爾幾乎在每個大洲都踢過足球,他將永遠成為球壇的傳說.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From the streets of Santos to becoming Brazils number one goal scorer, the 20-year journey of Neymar is one for the history books. Having played football on nearly every continent, Neymar will go down as a legend of the game, forever.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 傑拉德在長達20多年的輝煌職業生涯中體驗並成功晉身球壇巔峰,作為球員和教練捧起過獎盃,又代表過國家隊.但有高山就會伴隨低谷.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In an illustrious professional career that spans over 20 years, Gerrard has experienced and succeeded at the pinnacle of the sport, lifting trophies as a player and manager, and representing his country. But with the highs, came the lows.

epg.programme_title_en: Cristiano Ronaldo: The One And Only

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness the journey from the young Portuguese prodigy to one of the greatest players of all time. This is the one and only...Cristiano Ronaldo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大象團隊在今集迎來令人震驚的消息,獸醫們擔心他們救助的一隻小企鵝,我們也瞭解到如何真正需要一個社區來為動物園提供食物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, theres shocking news for the elephant team, the vets are concerned about one of their rescued Little penguins, and we find out how it really does take a community to feed the Zoo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 由牠們的齒與爪,到令人難以置信的隱身和狡猾,大自然最致命的掠食者進化出一系列令人震驚的狩獵技術.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From their teeth, and claws, to incredible stealth and cunning, nature’s most lethal predators have evolved a staggering array of hunting techniques.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集見證大自然最非凡的動物遷徙,並發現牠們為了生存而必須出走多遠.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode we witness nature’s most extraordinary animal migrations, and discover the lengths they must go to, in order to survive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 動物嬰兒:為了嬰兒免受極端情況,飢餓掠食者和飢餓威脅,所有動物都必須為其物種的未來而戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Baby Animals: Protecting babies against extreme conditions, hungry predators, and the threat of starvation, all animals must fight for the future of their species.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 森美拉發掘印度美食的起源.她尋找獨家和可靠的地方,說服廚師分享部分秘密,與街頭小販一起煮食,並浪蕩到古老的印度香料市場,帶你一瞥印度豐富的烹飪傳統,
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Samira convinces chefs to part with their secrets, cooks with street vendors and wanders into ancient spice markets to give you a peek into India’s rich culinary heritage.

epg.programme_title_en: Battle Of Midway: The True Story
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 深入瞭解中途島海戰,大戰時雙方使用的飛機,以及一位戰鬥機機師的戲劇性故事,還有他在美國第一次太平洋戰爭獲得真正勝利中的關鍵作用.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: An inside look at the Battle of Midway, the aircraft used on both sides of the fight, and the dramatic story of one fighter pilot and his pivotal role in America’s first true victory of the Pacific War.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從巨型媒體帝國的女繼承人到被通緝的重犯,見證1974年的派蒂赫茲綁架奇案.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From heiress of a giant media empire to wanted felon, witness the strange saga of the Patty Hearst kidnapping of 1974.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 以當時報導山姆之子的方式呈現事件,讓你沉浸在這謀殺案的戲劇中.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Immerse yourself in the drama of the Son of Sam murders, presented the way the events were covered at the time.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利前往義大利西西里島的巴勒摩,並用上即捕的吞拿魚在海灘上準備海鮮麵食.他又品嚐了包括炸魷魚,釀沙甸魚和島上獨特香蒜醬的地道美食.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ainsley travels to Palermo on the Italian island of Sicily and prepares seafood pasta on the beach, using freshly caught tuna; Ainsley samples local delicacies including fried calamari, stuffed sardines and the islands unique recipe for pesto.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利前往臺灣,發現它是世上最偉大的美食聖地之一.他發現香燉魚和辣炒豬肉,並用大蒜和辣椒煮臺灣大蝦.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ainsley travels to Taiwan and discovers it is one of the greatest food destinations in the world. He finds fragrant braised fish and chilli pork stir-fry, and cooks Taiwan prawns with garlic and chilli.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利發現馬德裡是個充滿秘密的城市.首先這個沉迷美食的城市禁止街頭美食.那麼當地人如何繞過這道禁令呢?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ainsley discovers that Madrid is a city of secrets. The first one comes as a bit of a shock: street food is banned in this food-obsessed city. So how do the locals get round this?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利來到摩洛哥,但他沒有去馬拉喀什或卡薩布蘭加,而是去了豐富多彩,混亂而夢幻的費茲.雜亂無序的麥地那是世界遺產,也是通往另一個時代的門戶.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ainsley lands in Morocco, but he doesnt go to Marrakesch or Casablanca, but to the colourful, chaotic and dreamy city of Fes. The sprawling medina is a World Heritage site and a gateway to another time.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利到訪檳島首都喬治敦,馬來西亞人發現這個沉迷美食的國家中最好的街頭食品.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ainsley visits Georgetown, the capital of Penang island, where Malaysians come to discover the best street food in this food-obsessed country.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利在美食之旅的最後一站到訪問約旦的安曼,那是來自伊拉克,黎巴嫩,巴勒斯坦和敘利亞中東一族叫作家的交匯處.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: On the final leg of his culinary journey, Ainsley visits Amman in Jordan, the crossroads in the Middle East that families from Iraq, Lebanon, Palestine and Syria now call home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 巴拉克歐巴馬是首位非裔美國總統,體現了希望,正義,寬容和平等,以他的信息和傳承啟發數百萬人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Barack Obama, the 1st African-American US President, embodied hope, justice, tolerance, and equality, inspiring millions with his message and legacy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索比爾柯林頓複雜的影響,從阿肯色州起家到白宮的高山(經濟繁榮)與低谷(醜聞,彈劾),以及他對美國政治的影響.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore Bill Clintons complex legacy, from Arkansas roots to White House highs (economic prosperity) and lows (scandals, impeachment), and his impact on American politics.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本紀錄片審視喬治小布希的總統任期,尤其是伊拉克戰爭,其後遺症以及他的決定帶來的持久影響,包括伊斯蘭國的崛起和衝突造成的傷亡.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Documentary examines George W. Bushs presidency, focusing on the Iraq War, its aftermath, and the lasting impact of his decisions, including the rise of ISIS and the human toll of the conflict.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 翱翔於廣闊的沙漠,巨大的鑽石和 世上最大的內陸綠洲之上.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Soar over vast deserts, enormous diamonds, and the worlds largest inland oasis.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從數千英尺高空探索西開普省迷人的海岸線,注目的山脈和多樣性的大都會.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore the Western Capes stunning shorelines, dramatic mountains, and richly-diverse metropolis, from thousands of feet in the air.

epg.programme_title_en: Alaska: A Year In The Wild #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著春季來臨,日照變長,氣溫上升.不過,阿拉斯加只有短暫的春季.動物只有兩個月時間來覓食和組織家庭,還要避開獵食者.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With the arrival of spring, days grow longer and temperatures rise. However, spring in Alaska is short. Animals have just two months to find food and start a family, while avoiding predators.

epg.programme_title_en: Alaska: A Year In The Wild #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿拉斯加已進入夏季.這為世上最大規模之一的阿拉斯加三文魚遷徙準備了舞臺.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Summer has arrived in Alaska.This sets the scene for one of the worlds greatest migrations of the Alaskan salmon run.

epg.programme_title_en: Alaska: A Year In The Wild #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 座頭鯨回歸阿拉斯加豐饒的食堂,三文魚則回到河流產卵.不過,牠們必須跟飢餓的棕熊討一條生路.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Humpback whales return to Alaskas rich feeding grounds and salmon return to spawn in the rivers. The returning salmon however have to negotiate a path past hungry brown bears.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在聖露西亞,雙胞胎驚喜現身梅茜的度假之旅,帆船探險,叢林健行,極致享受的巧克力按摩,蘭姆酒品鑑,熱帶樂趣無限延伸!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Saint Lucia, the twins crash Maisie’s getaway for a whirlwind of sailing adventures, jungle hikes, decadent chocolate massages, rum tastings, and endless tropical fun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在冰島,邦妮與雙胞胎展開史詩冒險--賞鯨,火山健行,策馬奔馳,還有極光下的深度環保對話.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Iceland, Bonnie teams up with the twins for an epic escape-whale watching, volcano trekking, horseback riding, and inspiring eco chats under the midnight sun.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 以當時報導山姆之子的方式呈現事件,讓你沉浸在這謀殺案的戲劇中.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Immerse yourself in the drama of the Son of Sam murders, presented the way the events were covered at the time.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《生存邊緣》檢視全球生物圈所面臨的存亡威脅,以及對地球和奧特亞羅瓦(紐西蘭)的未來代表著甚麼.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Edge of Existence examines existential threats to the worlds biosphere and what it means for the future of the planet, and Aotearoa.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《生存邊緣》探索人類有史以來面臨的最大存亡風險之一的未來- 一個生化威脅.從病毒到人造流行病和合成生化武器,科技正加速人造威脅的風險.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Edge of Existence explores a future where bio-threats present one of the greatest existential risks that humanity has ever faced. From viruses to man-made pandemics and synthetic bio-weapons, technology is accelerating the risks of man-made threats.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這塊巨大的磁石將徹底改變世界和產能的未來.法國南部正建造目前世上最大的核融合反應堆.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This giant magnet will revolutionize the world and energy production in the future. The worlds largest nuclear fusion reactor is currently under construction in southern France.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 重新檢視新春攻勢:兩個月的戰役殺死了超過15,000名美國和盟軍士兵,並引發了美國各地的反戰示威.探索報告,圖像和戰鬥片段,當中大部分自1968年以後就再沒出現過.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rediscover the Tet Offensive: two months of battles that killed more than 15,000 American and Allied troops, and triggered anti-war protests across the U.S. Explore reports, images, and combat footage, much of which hasn’t been seen since 1968.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 按時序再體驗太陽神13號險些釀成的災難,這是美國太空總署同時最具破壞性和最美好的時刻之一.通過新聞片段,任務控制的音頻和美國太空總署的存檔見證1970年4月的事件.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience a chronological recounting of the Apollo 13 near-disaster, one of NASA’s most devastating-and finest-moments. Witness the events of April 1970 as they unfolded through news footage, mission control audio, and NASA archives.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 通過警察的音頻和視頻,還有當地及國家新聞報道,審 視2002年華盛頓特區的狙擊手襲擊事件.狙擊手為期三週的恐怖統治引發了美國史上最激烈,最複雜的搜捕行動之一.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Examine the 2002 sniper attacks in Washington D.C. through police audio and video, as well as local and national news reports. The sniper’s three-week reign of terror triggered one of the most intense and complicated manhunts in American history.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 透過罕見的檔案錄像審視民權社運人士麥爾坎X的迅速崛起和悲劇下場.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: See the meteoric rise and tragic end of civil rights activist Malcolm X, captured by rarely seen archival footage.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 透過檔案錄像見證柯林頓總統被彈劾當天的故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness the story of President Clintons impeachment, presented through archival footage of the day.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本紀錄片審視喬治小布希的總統任期,尤其是伊拉克戰爭,其後遺症以及他的決定帶來的持久影響,包括伊斯蘭國的崛起和衝突造成的傷亡.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Documentary examines George W. Bushs presidency, focusing on the Iraq War, its aftermath, and the lasting impact of his decisions, including the rise of ISIS and the human toll of the conflict.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 朗奴雷根是一位有魅力的領袖,他用列根經濟學將美國轉營,在國內外有著不同意見,又用他富有遠見的政策和標誌性的演講永遠改變保守主義.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ronald Reagan, a charismatic leader, transformed America with Reaganomics, dividing opinion at home and abroad, and forever changing Conservatism with his visionary policies and iconic speeches.

epg.programme_title_en: Keanu Reeves: The One And Only
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 踏上基努・李維的人生旅程,回顧他的成長歲月,多變的影視作品,以及情感起伏,揭開這位備受愛戴的偶像魅力所在.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The journey of Keanu Reeves, travel through his youth, his versatile filmography and his many emotinal peaks and troughs to uncover what makes this fantastic icon so celebrated.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從數千英尺高空探索西開普省迷人的海岸線,注目的山脈和多樣性的大都會.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore the Western Capes stunning shorelines, dramatic mountains, and richly-diverse metropolis, from thousands of feet in the air.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 要觀察這片充滿地質現象的土地,只能從高空欣賞其雄偉的真面貌.從散佈在海岸線上被遺忘的沉船到卡奧科蘭無解的仙女圈,納米比亞的秘密將被揭開.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Observe a land filled with geological phenomena whose majesty can only truly be appreciated from the sky. From forgotten shipwrecks strewn along the coastline to the unexplained fairy circles in Koakoveld, Namibias secrets will be revealed.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Autumn is when stags compete to breed, osprey chicks begin a 3000-mile migration to West Africa, salmon return to the rivers where they were born and adders give birth to live young.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The winter is mild and wet, which is good news for some but bad news for others. Red deer are forced to higher ground, salmon have gone six months without food, mountain hares turn a conspicuous white, and squirrels kick their own young out of the ne

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ben takes a boat to visit a salmon farm in Akaroa and learns the difference between NZ King and Atlantic salmon. He catches salmon and cooks it on the shoreline overlooking the harbour. He checks out a high-quality homegrown culinary oil that’s both

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S4 #6
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 正值核果盛產季節!Ben 造訪中奧塔哥一個由家族經營的果園,該果園以核果產季長,與土地及社區的緊密連結而聞名.他發現了一座全電力運作的櫻桃農場,將優質外銷櫻桃直接販售給紐西蘭民眾.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It’s stone fruit season! Ben visits a family run orchard in Central Otago known for its long season of stone fruit and a strong connection to the land and community. He discovers an all-electric cherry farm where premium export cherries are sold dire

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Saint Lucia, the twins crash Maisie’s getaway for a whirlwind of sailing adventures, jungle hikes, decadent chocolate massages, rum tastings, and endless tropical fun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在冰島,邦妮與雙胞胎展開史詩冒險--賞鯨,火山健行,策馬奔馳,還有極光下的深度環保對話.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Iceland, Bonnie teams up with the twins for an epic escape-whale watching, volcano trekking, horseback riding, and inspiring eco chats under the midnight sun.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: From their teeth, and claws, to incredible stealth and cunning, nature’s most lethal predators have evolved a staggering array of hunting techniques.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集見證大自然最非凡的動物遷徙,並發現牠們為了生存而必須出走多遠.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode we witness nature’s most extraordinary animal migrations, and discover the lengths they must go to, in order to survive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 動物嬰兒:為了嬰兒免受極端情況,飢餓掠食者和飢餓威脅,所有動物都必須為其物種的未來而戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Baby Animals: Protecting babies against extreme conditions, hungry predators, and the threat of starvation, all animals must fight for the future of their species.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這具百萬年歷史的巨大杜爾福長毛象骨骸,急需進行世界首創的緊急修復.我們跟隨這個艱鉅的拆卸和重組脆弱化石的過程.透過電腦成像技術(CGI)和博物館知識,這部影片讓這個引人入勝卻鮮為人知的巨型生物重獲生命.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 討人喜歡,被視為滑稽的海鸚是冰島的國家象徵,但牠的命運令人擔憂.長達十年,海鸚伴侶停止繁殖.少數當地熱心人士現已動員起來,力挽狂瀾,拯救這種備受喜愛的海鳥.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The endearing, comical puffin is Icelands national emblem, but its fate is concerning. For a decade, couples have stopped breeding. A handful of local enthusiasts are now mobilized to save this beloved seabird.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在智利託雷斯德爾潘恩,雪山融水注入指狀峽灣,延伸至海洋並匯入洋流,降低海水鹽度.河口,濕地孕育眾多涉禽,而無數海灣與港口則吸引稀有的海豚與虎鯨.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Chiles Torres del Paine melt from snow-covered mountains feeds finger-like fjords as they reach out to the sea to join the current lowering its salinity. Rivers estuaries and wetlands are home to many wading birds and the countless inlets and bay

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 洪堡洋流雖比多數洋流緩慢,卻是世界上最具活力的洋流之一,因其行經距離極長.深海海溝的湧升流將養分帶至海面,使浮遊植物大量繁盛,奠定複雜海洋食物鏈的基礎.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Examine the 2002 sniper attacks in Washington D.C. through police audio and video, as well as local and national news reports. The sniper’s three-week reign of terror triggered one of the most intense and complicated manhunts in American history.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 透過罕見的檔案錄像審視民權社運人士麥爾坎X的迅速崛起和悲劇下場.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: See the meteoric rise and tragic end of civil rights activist Malcolm X, captured by rarely seen archival footage.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 透過檔案錄像見證柯林頓總統被彈劾當天的故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness the story of President Clintons impeachment, presented through archival footage of the day.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從巨型媒體帝國的女繼承人到被通緝的重犯,見證1974年的派蒂赫茲綁架奇案.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From heiress of a giant media empire to wanted felon, witness the strange saga of the Patty Hearst kidnapping of 1974.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 以當時報導山姆之子的方式呈現事件,讓你沉浸在這謀殺案的戲劇中.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Immerse yourself in the drama of the Son of Sam murders, presented the way the events were covered at the time.

epg.programme_title_en: Battle Of Midway: The True Story
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 深入瞭解中途島海戰,大戰時雙方使用的飛機,以及一位戰鬥機機師的戲劇性故事,還有他在美國第一次太平洋戰爭獲得真正勝利中的關鍵作用.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: An inside look at the Battle of Midway, the aircraft used on both sides of the fight, and the dramatic story of one fighter pilot and his pivotal role in America’s first true victory of the Pacific War.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沿著非洲南部海岸觀賞古老的海蝕洞,現代的高爾夫球場,神秘的地質構造和危險的掠食者.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: See ancient sea caves, modern golf courses, mysterious formations, and treacherous predators along Africas South Coast.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從空中俯瞰南非的山脈,繁囂的都市和野性難馴的動物.這是南非從史前骨頭到現代摩天大廈的旅程.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: View South Africas mountain ranges, bustling cities and untamed wildlife from the air. This is South Africas journey from pre-human skeletons to modern Skyscrapers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 翱翔於廣闊的沙漠,巨大的鑽石和 世上最大的內陸綠洲之上.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Soar over vast deserts, enormous diamonds, and the worlds largest inland oasis.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從數千英尺高空探索西開普省迷人的海岸線,注目的山脈和多樣性的大都會.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore the Western Capes stunning shorelines, dramatic mountains, and richly-diverse metropolis, from thousands of feet in the air.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 要觀察這片充滿地質現象的土地,只能從高空欣賞其雄偉的真面貌.從散佈在海岸線上被遺忘的沉船到卡奧科蘭無解的仙女圈,納米比亞的秘密將被揭開.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Observe a land filled with geological phenomena whose majesty can only truly be appreciated from the sky. From forgotten shipwrecks strewn along the coastline to the unexplained fairy circles in Koakoveld, Namibias secrets will be revealed.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在豐富多彩的非洲國家-尚比亞上空翱翔.包括世上最富有的人所打造的城市和擠滿世上最貧窮的人的市場.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Soar over the richly diverse, African nation of Zambia. Including cities crafted by the worlds richest men and markets teeming with some of the worlds poorest people.

epg.programme_title_en: Alaska: A Year In The Wild #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著春季來臨,日照變長,氣溫上升.不過,阿拉斯加只有短暫的春季.動物只有兩個月時間來覓食和組織家庭,還要避開獵食者.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With the arrival of spring, days grow longer and temperatures rise. However, spring in Alaska is short. Animals have just two months to find food and start a family, while avoiding predators.

epg.programme_title_en: Alaska: A Year In The Wild #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿拉斯加已進入夏季.這為世上最大規模之一的阿拉斯加三文魚遷徙準備了舞臺.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Summer has arrived in Alaska.This sets the scene for one of the worlds greatest migrations of the Alaskan salmon run.

epg.programme_title_en: Alaska: A Year In The Wild #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 座頭鯨回歸阿拉斯加豐饒的食堂,三文魚則回到河流產卵.不過,牠們必須跟飢餓的棕熊討一條生路.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Humpback whales return to Alaskas rich feeding grounds and salmon return to spawn in the rivers. The returning salmon however have to negotiate a path past hungry brown bears.

epg.programme_title_en: Loch Lomond: A Year In The Wild #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 秋季是雄鹿爭相繁殖,魚鷹雛鳥開展3000英裡西非遷徙,三文魚返回牠們出生的河流,極北蝰產子的季節.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Autumn is when stags compete to breed, osprey chicks begin a 3000-mile migration to West Africa, salmon return to the rivers where they were born and adders give birth to live young.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Ali the elephant at Shoushan Zoo, carries the childhood memories of many children, both young and old. Although he is now 49 years old, he is still energetic under the care of the keepers. Once the new zoo is completed, the public will be able to see "Ali" again. When the caregiver helps Ali take a shower, Ali will take the opportunity to replenish his body with water; sometimes he will step on water in the pool and use his nose to enjoy the fun of playing in the water. 
There are currently only three African elephants in Taiwan. In addition to Ali, the other two are in the Taipei City Zoo. Because African elephants are endangered wild animals, their import and export are strictly controlled. If these three elephants die in the future, Taiwan may no longer see any African elephants. Shoushan Zoo vows to take good care of "Ali" so that "Ali's" heartwarming story can continue, and shoulder the mission of life education, so that everyone's visit to the Shoushan Zoo is the starting point of happy memories. In addition to Ali the elephant, Shoushan Zoo currently has two white rhinos, male "Xiqi" from the Taipei City Zoo and female "Baby" who was bred naturally in the zoo. 
White rhino "Xiqi" was loaned to Shoushan Zoo in hope that he could successfully mate with the female white rhino "Baby" to raise the white rhino population.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Ali the elephant at Shoushan Zoo, carries the childhood memories of many children, both young and old. Although he is now 49 years old, he is still energetic under the care of the keepers. Once the new zoo is completed, the public will be able to see "Ali" again. When the caregiver helps Ali take a shower, Ali will take the opportunity to replenish his body with water; sometimes he will step on water in the pool and use his nose to enjoy the fun of playing in the water. 
There are currently only three African elephants in Taiwan. In addition to Ali, the other two are in the Taipei City Zoo. Because African elephants are endangered wild animals, their import and export are strictly controlled. If these three elephants die in the future, Taiwan may no longer see any African elephants. Shoushan Zoo vows to take good care of "Ali" so that "Ali's" heartwarming story can continue, and shoulder the mission of life education, so that everyone's visit to the Shoushan Zoo is the starting point of happy memories. In addition to Ali the elephant, Shoushan Zoo currently has two white rhinos, male "Xiqi" from the Taipei City Zoo and female "Baby" who was bred naturally in the zoo. 
White rhino "Xiqi" was loaned to Shoushan Zoo in hope that he could successfully mate with the female white rhino "Baby" to raise the white rhino population.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The white cockatoo is one of the more common macaw species, but its number in the wild has gradually declined in recent years. Hand-reared white cockatoos love to be close to their owners. Their large size is one of their features. Like other large macaws, white cockatoos are really loud, but if it's a hand-reared bird raised from a young age, the situation of screaming will be much better. If you want to raise a pair of adult birds, it is ideal to keep them in an open area with good sound insulation or without neighbors. Their friendly personalities make them one of the more suitable large macaw species as pets.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Samira is in New York, getting ready for an exciting trip back home to India, where she re-visits Indian cuisine with her New York culinary trained eye. She packs her bags and sets off. 

New York’s signature street food is the hot dog. In India, street food is a highly developed cuisine all on its own, going back hundreds of years. Samira has her own take on the shammi kabab and turns them into mini burgers in her kitchen, before traipsing all over New Delhi in her Essence of India auto rickshaw devouring the hearty Samosa, the succulent Kathi wraps, the moorishly moist Biryanis and even ends up taking over a street cart with a smorgasbord of sweet, tangy and spicy Indian chaat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
The whole world loves a good curry, and living in New York, Samira loves to make curries, Indian, South East Asian and the Western stew, but she heads back to India where she learns how to make some of India’s finest curries. 

Here is the story of ultimate deliciousness -- the tale of the curry. The desire to perfect her skills, sets her off on a curry trail, seeking out the best chefs in Delhi and getting them to spill their secrets. 

This episode travels through the kitchens of master chefs, who created the king of all curries, The Butter Chicken, reintroduces the authentic korma, a recipe that has been tweaked across the globe and tells the story of the Raja Mirch, the hottest pepper in the world.

Here is the story of ultimate deliciousness -- the tale of the curry. The desire to perfect her skills, sets her off on a curry trail, seeking out the best chefs in Delhi and getting them to spill their secrets. 

This episode travels through the kitchens of master chefs, who created the king of all curries, The Butter Chicken, reintroduces the authentic korma, a recipe that has been tweaked across the globe and tells the story of the Raja Mirch, the hottest pepper in the world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
A forbidden city that was built hundreds of miles away from the capital in Beijing, still stands today on the hills and crests of this mountain, its peak serves as a ladder to heaven. The mysteries of this now deserted structure, which served both a ruler and a deity, are slowly being revealed. Wudang Mountain stands, aloof, veiled in mysterious tales of ancient gods and rich in imperial history. 
Its ridges stretch, shrouded with clouds and mist all year round. 
Discover China brings you the Mystery of XuanWu, a riveting tale of the bond between an emperor and a god, the link between man and nature, and the story behind WuDang Mountain, and its mystifying peaks.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Starting at The Good Earth Food & Wine Co. in the Lincoln-Lakeshore sub-Appalachian, the duo meets vibrant and engaging Nicolette Novak who introduces them to the ‘three date’ sip test, Cabernet Franc, the mystery of Rosé and ultimately, the mouthwatering Good Earth Burger.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: No one could have dreamed that beneath the fields of a slumbering village in Henan province, a dormant civilization was awaiting to be brought back to light. From the discovery of mysteriously etched and engraved bone fragments and tortoise shells, an age old era of China emerged from beneath the plowed fields. As archeological excavations began, an age old fear of grave robbers set in the surveyor’s heart , when the wall of an ancient tomb was finally exposed. As the arduous explorations continued, an age in China’s history was finally uncovered. Discover China unearths the secrets of the Underground City.

Today though, it’s the 365 beaches, year round sunshine, and colourful cocktails that bring the visitors.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: No one could have dreamed that beneath the fields of a slumbering village in Henan province, a dormant civilization was awaiting to be brought back to light. From the discovery of mysteriously etched and engraved bone fragments and tortoise shells, an age old era of China emerged from beneath the plowed fields. As archeological excavations began, an age old fear of grave robbers set in the surveyor’s heart , when the wall of an ancient tomb was finally exposed. As the arduous explorations continued, an age in China’s history was finally uncovered. Discover China unearths the secrets of the Underground City.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: In the remote, ancient villages of southern Anhui Province in southeast China, a breed of merchants emerged, altering  and reshaping the face of China’s trade and commerce. Cast in to the tumultuous world of business at a tender, early age, these boys turned into some of China’s most successful traders, businessmen and merchants. With their legacy firmly secure in their centuries old lavish and opulent houses, and their illustrious careers recorded in the annals of history for posterity, these shrewd astute, and influential merchants helped shape China’s commercial past for centuries. Discover China follows in the footsteps of the famous Huizhou Merchants.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Located on the ancient Silk Road, Dunhuang Oasis was the epicenter of an amazing discovery at the turn of the century. Taoist monk Wang Yuan Lu, who was appointed to care for a Buddhist holy place, was displeased with his position. A fateful sweep of the broom revealed a secret cache of thousands of Buddhist scrolls, unlocking the secrets held within the Sutra Cave. Over 50,000 artifacts, murals, statues, idols spanning the history of 12 different Chinese Dynasties were discovered. News of the find led to the discovery of the Mogao Grottoes by a British explorer who was surveying the ruins in the area. Fascinated by the find, Sir Marc Aurel Stein led the first of several foreign expeditions who bargained with the monk for these priceless artifacts, leaving the Mogao Grottos nearly empty. To this day, China is still heart broken at the loss.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Located on the ancient Silk Road, Dunhuang Oasis was the epicenter of an amazing discovery at the turn of the century. Taoist monk Wang Yuan Lu, who was appointed to care for a Buddhist holy place, was displeased with his position. A fateful sweep of the broom revealed a secret cache of thousands of Buddhist scrolls, unlocking the secrets held within the Sutra Cave. Over 50,000 artifacts, murals, statues, idols spanning the history of 12 different Chinese Dynasties were discovered. News of the find led to the discovery of the Mogao Grottoes by a British explorer who was surveying the ruins in the area. Fascinated by the find, Sir Marc Aurel Stein led the first of several foreign expeditions who bargained with the monk for these priceless artifacts, leaving the Mogao Grottos nearly empty. To this day, China is still heart broken at the loss.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
An age old sketching of plans for an imperial garden design drew the attention of two prominent Chinese architectural scholars. Upon further examination, they were shocked to discover he sketch’s true origins and exactly what the blueprints depicted. In their quest for more information, they unraveled the secret methods of construction for the world’s largest palace complex: The Forbidden City. 
From the blueprints, to small scale models, to the ingenious construction solutions conceived which brought a family, generations of success and wealth. 
Discover China delves into the foundations of how this impressive palace is constructed and provide detailed examination of Imperial Architectural Designs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
An age old sketching of plans for an imperial garden design drew the attention of two prominent Chinese architectural scholars. Upon further examination, they were shocked to discover he sketch’s true origins and exactly what the blueprints depicted. In their quest for more information, they unraveled the secret methods of construction for the world’s largest palace complex: The Forbidden City. 
From the blueprints, to small scale models, to the ingenious construction solutions conceived which brought a family, generations of success and wealth. 
Discover China delves into the foundations of how this impressive palace is constructed and provide detailed examination of Imperial Architectural Designs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Looming across northern China, The Great Wall sits atop the crests, ridges and mountain tops, sprawling like a slumbering dragon. Through the ages, it has been stormed by marauding Mongolians, hailed as the ultimate defensive wall, and is one of China’s most magnificent accomplishments and first iconic image. The Great Wall has witnessed the waxing and waning of numerous dynasties and outcomes of many historic transformations. Its secrets of construction are still being uncovered, as well as revealing the stories left behind by those who constructed it. The generations, in an age where The Great Wall no longer serves its purpose, enjoys a life peace in a once threatened nation. 
Discover China marches across the great wall’s Wartorn Frontiers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Samira is in New York, getting ready for an exciting trip back home to India, where she re-visits Indian cuisine with her New York culinary trained eye. She packs her bags and sets off. 

New York’s signature street food is the hot dog. In India, street food is a highly developed cuisine all on its own, going back hundreds of years. Samira has her own take on the shammi kabab and turns them into mini burgers in her kitchen, before traipsing all over New Delhi in her Essence of India auto rickshaw devouring the hearty Samosa, the succulent Kathi wraps, the moorishly moist Biryanis and even ends up taking over a street cart with a smorgasbord of sweet, tangy and spicy Indian chaat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: This ancient city, once threatened by the teeth of modern development, stands proud as one of China’s defining economical centers, and one of the few to retain their original visage. The institutions honed and developed in this ancient city have long been lost, but the city’s remarkable architecture and history remain very much intact.  The pioneers of the Chinese financial system came from this city, making their marks in every corner of the country. Their influence swelled well beyond the thick city walls, leaving behind an impressive legacy of commerce, finance and business. Discover China, as we unlock the vault containing the valuable secrets of Ancient Pingyao.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Samira is in New York, getting ready for an exciting trip back home to India, where she re-visits Indian cuisine with her New York culinary trained eye. She packs her bags and sets off. 

New York’s signature street food is the hot dog. In India, street food is a highly developed cuisine all on its own, going back hundreds of years. Samira has her own take on the shammi kabab and turns them into mini burgers in her kitchen, before traipsing all over New Delhi in her Essence of India auto rickshaw devouring the hearty Samosa, the succulent Kathi wraps, the moorishly moist Biryanis and even ends up taking over a street cart with a smorgasbord of sweet, tangy and spicy Indian chaat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: This ancient city, once threatened by the teeth of modern development, stands proud as one of China’s defining economical centers, and one of the few to retain their original visage. The institutions honed and developed in this ancient city have long been lost, but the city’s remarkable architecture and history remain very much intact.  The pioneers of the Chinese financial system came from this city, making their marks in every corner of the country. Their influence swelled well beyond the thick city walls, leaving behind an impressive legacy of commerce, finance and business. Discover China, as we unlock the vault containing the valuable secrets of Ancient Pingyao.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
The whole world loves a good curry, and living in New York, Samira loves to make curries, Indian, South East Asian and the Western stew, but she heads back to India where she learns how to make some of India’s finest curries. 

Here is the story of ultimate deliciousness -- the tale of the curry. The desire to perfect her skills, sets her off on a curry trail, seeking out the best chefs in Delhi and getting them to spill their secrets. 

This episode travels through the kitchens of master chefs, who created the king of all curries, The Butter Chicken, reintroduces the authentic korma, a recipe that has been tweaked across the globe and tells the story of the Raja Mirch, the hottest pepper in the world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
A forbidden city that was built hundreds of miles away from the capital in Beijing, still stands today on the hills and crests of this mountain, its peak serves as a ladder to heaven. The mysteries of this now deserted structure, which served both a ruler and a deity, are slowly being revealed. Wudang Mountain stands, aloof, veiled in mysterious tales of ancient gods and rich in imperial history. 
Its ridges stretch, shrouded with clouds and mist all year round. 
Discover China brings you the Mystery of XuanWu, a riveting tale of the bond between an emperor and a god, the link between man and nature, and the story behind WuDang Mountain, and its mystifying peaks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
This film about caving is not meant for cavers. It was made for
all those people who stay outside and ask questions such as: " How can you breathe? ", “Aren’t you afraid of being trapped there?" "But...what do you do in there?" Speleology films often talk about the caves. But they rarely talk about speleologists. Who are these strange people who live unlike others?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: China is usually seen through the lens of economics, politics and a regimented population. But in Stepping Out we meet people who have left home and set out on the road to discover their China and themselves. Su Min, who feels she has done her duty as daughter, wife, mother and grandmother and in her 50’s left her abusive husband; Kiwi, a two-year-old whose parents lost their jobs in the pandemic and not owning a house, travel China in their RV as a family; and Alex a graphic designer exploring his country with his retired mother. Through their travels and their lives, we see a different life in China – a freedom to travel, explore, visit amazing places but taking all the benefits of technology to promote themselves and make a living. The film was made in July 2022 by students from CUC Nanjing and is directed by their tutor.
